task_original_statement: Given a list of closed intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and output the merged intervals sorted by start.

input_direct.prompt: Read an integer N followed by N lines each containing two integers l r (l <= r). Intervals are closed. Merge any intervals that overlap or touch (i.e., next.start <= current.end). Output each merged interval as "l r" on its own line, sorted by l.
instructions: If two intervals touch at a point, they must be merged.
Output one merged interval per line.

model_input.task_description: Read N closed intervals (l r). Merge intervals that overlap or touch (next.start <= current.end). Output merged intervals sorted by l, one per line as "l r".
